fact_types.title: A presented successor claim (ADR-0063) for a legacy Schedule B accrued-interest adjustment finding retired by tax.us.2025.scheduleb-accrued-interest.succession. Carries only what the retired legacy finding already attested; a person asserts this presented claim itself if they still hold it -- it is never silently converted. Never a computation input: rule.form1040-line2b v6 does not read this symbol, so a workspace that has migrated resolves entirely through the pairing-scoped current-year-adjustment subtotal.

label: Successor vocabulary: presented claim for a migrated legacy accrued-interest finding (ADR-0072/ADR-0063)
